target_customer: Manufacturers and foundries with labor-intensive finishing work such as metal grinding
problem: Grinding and similar finishing work is dangerous, labor-intensive and high-mix, so traditional robot programming does not fit.
business_model: Software and robot-cell deployments for manufacturers (Proteus); pricing not found
product_category: AI software for industrial robot arms

founders.name: Siddharth Girdhar
founders.background_notes: Self-driving cars at Uber ATG, AI at Meta, multi-agent warehouse robot algorithms at Nimble.

founders.name: Vignesh Rajmohan
founders.background_notes: Motion planning at Google X, LLM applications for robotics in the Atkeson Lab, manipulation at ABB.

competitors.name: Kane Robotics
competitors.what: GRIT AI vision system for cobots doing weld and seam grinding

technical_complexity.rationale: Vision-guided contact-rich manipulation across many part variants using foundation vision models, with real foundry deployment.

defensibility.rationale: Deployed on 10+ robots at a foundry gives data and integration, but established robot integrators and vendors work on grinding.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not yet known; no sourced incumbent action against Pivot found.

market_need_then: Most grinding still manual and hazardous; a foundry made it a 10+ robot pilot (YC page).

brand_strength.rationale: Common word name, product name Proteus, little press found about the brand.

outcome_analysis: Pivot Robotics (YC W24) targets metal grinding with foundation-model vision and has a 10+ robot deployment at a cast-iron foundry. A July 2024 seed from NuVentures was reported without an amount. It is Active at 8 people; no later rounds were found, so it is early and unresolved. Founders have strong robotics and AI backgrounds, a plausible but unproven edge.
notes: Seed round amount undisclosed in reports; aggregators give $130K, $500K and $3.7M totals, all unverified. Other seed investors (Pioneer Fund, Unpopular Ventures) appear only in a search summary. Founder ages (24 and 25) appeared in a secondary profile only, so not recorded. Kane Robotics GRIT coverage is March 2024, near the batch. Company website pivotrobotics.com not fetched successfully in budget. Web Archive skipped.
